Pursuant to Nevada Revised Statutes (NRS) 649.020, we are required to provide you with the original creditor's name, which is First National Bank. We will also provide you with the charge-off date, which is January 11, 2022.

We will review the account history to determine the accuracy of your dispute. If our investigation confirms that the debt is not valid, we will take the necessary steps to remove the account from your credit report and provide you with a written confirmation of the deletion.

You have the right to further dispute this account if you believe our investigation is incomplete or inaccurate. Please note that you may request validation of the debt, but you have previously indicated that you do not wish to receive validation.

We will keep you informed of our progress and will provide you with a written update once our investigation is complete.
